cpu.cve_title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack Resource Exhaustion
cpu.mitre_technique: T1499.003 - Endpoint DoS: OS Exhaustion Flood
cpu.remediation_action: Apply HTTP/2 stream concurrency limits, deploy Envoy 1.28+, and enforce K8s CPU limits.

mem.cve_title: Redis Lua Sandbox Escape & Heap Overflow / Memory Starvation
mem.mitre_technique: T1499.001 - Endpoint DoS: OS Exhaustion Flood (Memory Heap)
mem.remediation_action: Upgrade In-Memory Cache/Redis, enforce cgroups memory limits, and configure Pod eviction.

delay.mitre_technique: T1498.001 - Network DoS: Direct Network Flood
delay.remediation_action: Implement gRPC keepalive ping frequency throttling and Istio circuit breaking.

loss.cve_title: Envoy/Istio Downstream Buffer Overflow Leading to Drop/Loss
loss.remediation_action: Upgrade Envoy sidecars >= 1.25.3, tune net.core.rmem_max, and configure MTU auto-detection.

disk.cve_title: Uncontrolled Temporary File Storage & Disk Volume Saturation
disk.mitre_technique: T1499.002 - Endpoint DoS: Service Exhaustion (Disk I/O)
disk.remediation_action: Mount emptyDir volumes with sizeLimit quotas, enforce 50MB logrotate, and configure alerts.

socket.cve_title: OpenSSL TLS Renegotiation / TCP Half-Open Connection Starvation
socket.mitre_technique: T1499.003 - Endpoint DoS: Socket / Port Exhaustion
socket.remediation_action: Set tcp_tw_reuse = 1 in host sysctl, configure HTTP client pool maxIdleConnections, and socket timeouts.

f1.cve_title: JDBC Driver / Object Deserialization Remote Crash & NPE
f1.remediation_action: Implement strict input schema validation, add null-safety checks, and upgrade JDBC client drivers.

f2.cve_title: Log4j Remote Code Execution & Resource Exhaustion (Log4Shell)

f3.cve_title: Spring Security Wildcard Pattern Authorization Mismatch & Failure
f3.remediation_action: Migrate to explicit requestMatchers() mapping in Spring Security 6+, avoid trailing slashes.
